queries.title: Onboarded devices not reporting (silent sensors)
queries.description: Devices marked Onboarded whose sensor is no longer Active or that haven't checked in for 7+ days. The portal's green status only reflects EDR telemetry reaching the cloud, so these silent sensors hide in plain sight.

queries.title: Devices that can be onboarded but aren't
queries.description: Devices Defender knows about and could manage, still sitting in 'Can be onboarded' state — the cross-system coverage gap between inventory and actual EDR protection.

queries.title: Antivirus configuration not compliant
queries.description: Devices failing one or more Defender Antivirus secure-configuration checks (real-time protection, signature freshness, tamper protection, etc.) from TVM's configuration assessment.

queries.title: Recent malware detections (last 7 days)
queries.description: Devices with malware-category alerts in the past week, ranked by distinct alert count with a sample of alert titles.

queries.title: Devices with high-severity alerts (last 30 days)
queries.description: Triage shortlist: devices carrying high-severity alerts in the past 30 days, ranked by distinct alert count with sample titles.
